$comment: Market news. target is a symbol or a sector (food, energy, entertainment, health, transport, tech, retail, finance, bond, all). impact = total log-return spread over `ticks` market days (0.08 ≈ +8%). direction for the Newsroom: up | down | flat. why explains the cause.

headlines.text: Byte Burger launches a hit new veggie burger, lines around the block!
headlines.entryText: Byte Burger made a yummy new burger. Everyone wants one!
headlines.why: More customers means more sales and profit, so investors pay more for the stock.

headlines.text: Byte Burger recalls fries after a supply mix-up
headlines.entryText: Byte Burger had to take back some fries. Oops!
headlines.why: Recalls cost money and hurt trust, so expected profits drop.

headlines.text: Solaris Power wins a contract to power all of Singapore's ports
headlines.entryText: Solaris Power will make sunshine power for a whole city's ports!
headlines.why: A big long-term contract means steady future revenue.

headlines.text: Cloudy season: solar output falls 20% this quarter
headlines.entryText: It's been cloudy, so solar panels made less power.
headlines.why: Less energy produced means less revenue this quarter.

headlines.text: PixelPlay's new game delayed by a year
headlines.entryText: PixelPlay's new game is late. Players have to wait!
headlines.why: Investors expected those sales soon; a delay pushes profit into the future and adds risk.

headlines.text: PixelPlay's 'Narwhal Racers' sells 10 million copies in a week
headlines.entryText: PixelPlay made a super popular game!
headlines.why: A blockbuster hit boosts revenue far above expectations.

headlines.text: Healio Health's new medicine approved by regulators
headlines.entryText: Healio Health's new medicine got approved to help people!
headlines.why: Approval lets the company finally sell a product it spent years developing.

headlines.text: Healio Health faces a lawsuit over clinic billing
headlines.entryText: Healio Health is in trouble for a billing mistake.
headlines.why: Legal costs and possible fines reduce expected profits.

headlines.text: ZoomRail opens a new line between New York and London (via tunnel!)
headlines.entryText: ZoomRail built a new super fast train line!
headlines.why: More routes, more riders, more ticket sales.

headlines.text: Fuel prices jump 15%
headlines.entryText: Gas got more expensive.
headlines.why: Transport companies pay more for fuel, which squeezes profit margins.

headlines.text: CloudKite signs every bank in Fin City as a customer
headlines.entryText: CloudKite got lots of new customers!
headlines.why: Big recurring contracts = predictable growing revenue.

headlines.text: CloudKite outage knocks apps offline for 6 hours
headlines.entryText: CloudKite's computers stopped working for a while.
headlines.why: Outages can cost refunds and make customers think about switching.

headlines.text: Greenleaf Grocers reports steady sales, as usual
headlines.entryText: Greenleaf Grocers is doing okay, like always.
headlines.why: No surprise means little change, prices already expected this.

headlines.text: Orbit Outfitters' moon sneaker sells out in minutes
headlines.entryText: Orbit's new sneakers sold out super fast!
headlines.why: Strong demand lets the company sell more at higher prices.

headlines.text: Shoppers cut back on clothes as prices rise
headlines.entryText: People are buying fewer clothes right now.
headlines.why: When budgets get tight, people cut 'wants' first, hurting retail sales.

headlines.text: Storm closes Hong Kong harbor for three days
headlines.entryText: A big storm closed the harbor for a few days.
headlines.why: Ships can't move cargo, so the shipping company loses revenue.

headlines.text: Global trade booms: record cargo through Singapore
headlines.entryText: Lots of ships are carrying boxes around the world!
headlines.why: More cargo means more shipping fees.

headlines.text: Sparkle Soda raises its dividend for the 10th year in a row
headlines.entryText: Sparkle Soda is paying its owners a little more money!
headlines.why: A rising dividend signals confident, steady profits.

headlines.text: RoboRanch robots fail a big farm test
headlines.entryText: RoboRanch's farm robots didn't work well in a test.
headlines.why: Risky companies are priced on future promises; failing a test shrinks that future.

headlines.text: RoboRanch lands deal with the world's biggest farm co-op
headlines.entryText: Lots of farms want RoboRanch robots now!
headlines.why: A huge customer makes the bold growth story more believable.

headlines.text: Fin City Reserve raises interest rates by 0.5%
headlines.entryText: The city bank made borrowing more expensive.
headlines.why: When new bonds pay more, older bonds paying less become less valuable, so bond prices fall.

headlines.text: Fin City Reserve cuts interest rates by 0.5%
headlines.entryText: The city bank made borrowing cheaper.
headlines.why: Older bonds with higher payments become more valuable when new rates fall.

headlines.text: Banks earn record profits as rates rise
headlines.entryText: Banks are making more money.
headlines.why: Banks earn more on loans when interest rates are higher.

headlines.text: Starlight Studios' movie flops at the box office
headlines.entryText: Starlight's new movie didn't sell many tickets.
headlines.why: The film cost a lot to make and didn't earn it back.

headlines.text: Starlight Studios opens a new theme park in Singapore
headlines.entryText: Starlight opened a fun new theme park!
headlines.why: New parks create years of ticket and merchandise sales.

headlines.text: Pet adoptions hit an all-time high
headlines.entryText: Lots of people are adopting pets!
headlines.why: More pets means more food, toys and grooming customers.

headlines.text: Economy report: jobs and spending both growing
headlines.entryText: People have jobs and are buying things. Good news!
headlines.why: A strong economy lifts most companies' earnings.

headlines.text: Economy report: shoppers worried, spending slows
headlines.entryText: People are worried and buying less.
headlines.why: Lower spending means lower expected profits across many companies.

headlines.text: Influencer claims 'MoonCoin' will 100x, Fin City regulators warn of scam
headlines.entryText: Someone says a coin will make you super rich. Careful, it might be a trick!
headlines.why: Hype isn't a reason for real companies to change. Promises of guaranteed huge returns are a classic scam signal.

headlines.text: Tech stocks soar as AI helpers become popular
headlines.entryText: Tech companies are growing fast!
headlines.why: Investors expect faster growth, so they pay more today.

headlines.text: Tech stocks tumble: 'prices got ahead of profits,' say analysts
headlines.entryText: Tech stock prices fell after going up a lot.
headlines.why: When prices rise faster than earnings (high P/E), any disappointment causes big drops.

headlines.text: Healthy-eating trend boosts grocery sales
headlines.entryText: People are buying more fruits and veggies!
headlines.why: More customers at Greenleaf means more revenue.

headlines.text: Heat wave! Soda sales up 30%
headlines.entryText: It's super hot, so people are buying cold drinks!
headlines.why: Weather can change demand for some products quickly.

headlines.text: Energy prices spike after a pipeline breaks
headlines.entryText: Energy got more expensive.
headlines.why: Energy producers can charge more while supply is short.

headlines.text: Inflation report: prices rising faster than expected
headlines.entryText: Things are getting more expensive faster.
headlines.why: Higher inflation usually pushes interest rates up, which lowers bond prices.

headlines.text: Fin City Bank Corp fined for hidden account fees
headlines.entryText: Fin City Bank Corp got in trouble for sneaky fees.
headlines.why: Fines cost money and customers may leave.

headlines.text: Orbit Outfitters CEO leaves suddenly
headlines.entryText: Orbit's boss quit all of a sudden.
headlines.why: Surprise leadership changes create uncertainty, and investors dislike uncertainty.

headlines.text: ZoomRail trains run 99.9% on time this year
headlines.entryText: ZoomRail trains are almost always on time!
headlines.why: Reliability keeps riders loyal; good but not shocking news.

headlines.text: Holiday shopping season beats forecasts
headlines.entryText: Stores sold lots of gifts this holiday!
headlines.why: Retailers earn a big share of their yearly profit in the holidays.

headlines.text: Global markets slide on trade worries
headlines.entryText: Markets all over the world went down a bit.
headlines.why: Uncertainty about trade can hurt many companies' future sales.
